## Overview

Edge AI places inference near the sensors and people that use its results.
Memory, processing capacity, power, and response time constrain the deployed
system. This learning path connects the principles in
[Introduction to Machine Learning Systems](https://mlsysbook.ai/vol1/) to
experiments on Linux edge devices and hardware accelerators.

[TinyML](../tinyml/index.qmd) applies these principles to microcontrollers.
Edge AI includes a broader range of devices, including single-board computers.
[Physical AI](../physical-ai/index.qmd) adds the requirements of acting on the
world and checking the resulting physical behavior. The paths share material,
but emphasize different deployment constraints.

## Read and experiment {#materials}

The textbook supplies the systems principles; the hardware materials provide
experiments in which to measure them. Python and introductory machine learning
provide a starting point, while each hardware guide specifies its own setup.

| Resource | Use |
|:---|:---|
| [Introduction to Machine Learning Systems](https://mlsysbook.ai/vol1/) | Study the lifecycle, model compression, hardware acceleration, and deployment constraints. |
| [MLSysBook Raspberry Pi kit](https://mlsysbook.ai/kits/contents/raspi/raspi.html) | Follow device setup and experiments in image classification, object detection, and local language and vision-language models. |
| [Edge AI Engineering](https://mjrovai.github.io/EdgeML_Made_Ease_ebook/) | Use Marcelo Rovai's companion book for hands-on Raspberry Pi deployment. |
| [Companion weekly labs](https://mjrovai.github.io/EdgeML_Made_Ease_ebook/weekly_labs.html) | Work through a sequence of setup, computer vision, and generative AI experiments. |

## For instructors {#for-instructors}

The companion book's
[weekly lab sequence](https://mjrovai.github.io/EdgeML_Made_Ease_ebook/weekly_labs.html)
provides an example teaching progression, hardware requirements, and assessment
criteria. The original author maintains these materials. They complement the
MLSysBook curriculum and are not a semester offering maintained on this site.

The [Instructor Hub](https://mlsysbook.ai/instructors/) provides general guidance
on pedagogy, assessment, and course adaptation. Hardware and compute requirements
depend on the selected model and device; each experiment should be reproduced on
the intended classroom configuration before it is assigned.

## Courses at other institutions

The [community course directory](../index.qmd) lists courses
that reference MLSysBook, including Edge AI offerings. Each institution maintains
its own syllabus, schedule, and enrollment information.
